name: Viktori Prism'Antras
summary: Above Darkshire, Viktori Prism'Antras keeps his gaze on the stars.

sections.title: Eyes Upon the Heavens
sections.body: Up the slope beyond the gryphon roost, Viktori Prism'Antras peers out from Duskwood's gloom. Undead incursions, ravenous spiders, and creeping shadows surround him, but his attention is fixed beyond the suffocating canopy. He hopes to build a fine optical telescope that will bring the stars into clear focus, giving him a quiet refuge from the dread engulfing the hamlet.

sections.title: Gnomish Schematics and Scattered Parts
sections.body: In this cursed forest, even a delicate telescope takes work to build. Viktori follows blueprints from his gnomish friend, Cog Glitzspinner. He asks passersby to find rare lens-crafting materials and mechanical housings, including finely cut glass and metal lenses scattered across perilous ground.

faq.answer: Viktori is an eccentric human stargazer in Darkshire. While the town faces political and supernatural threats, he devotes himself to building a telescope for studying the stars.

faq.q: Where can I find Viktori in Darkshire?
faq.answer: Viktori lives in a small wooden hut up the hill, just past the Darkshire gryphon master and to the right as you climb the path.

faq.q: What is Viktori trying to build?
faq.answer: Viktori is trying to build an astronomical telescope from blueprints by his gnomish colleague Cog Glitzspinner. It needs several specialized lenses and components.

faq.q: Why is he studying the stars from Duskwood?
faq.answer: Viktori is consumed by curiosity about the heavens despite Duskwood's darkness and terror. Studying the night sky gives him an intellectual refuge from the decaying land around him.

faq.q: Who designed the plans for Viktori's telescope?
faq.answer: Cog Glitzspinner, Viktori's inventive gnome acquaintance, designed the blueprints for the telescope.
No. Viktori is a civilian scholar, not a warrior, and leaves Darkshire's defense to Commander Althea Ebonlocke and the Night Watch. He devotes all his energies to his astronomical work.

angles.text: Tinkers will appreciate Viktori's project: his precision-built viewing instrument depends on sophisticated gnomish schematics.
Viktori's project depends on the ingenuity of Cog Glitzspinner, showing how far gnomish engineering reaches, even in the most desolate human towns.
Helping Viktori gives you a rare, peaceful pursuit in Darkshire as an Alliance townsman seeks wonder amid pervasive tragedy.
